LAB NOTES - experiment:modified_ramsey: rate conventions (symmetric, gamma per state): tau_dwell = 1/gamma; ACF ~ exp(-2 gamma t) so tau_corr = 1/(2 gamma) (lag 0 excluded: carries readout-noise variance); Lorentzian PSD corner f_c = gamma/pi; asymmetric rates: ACF/PSD see gamma_eff = (g01+g10)/2. Drift = centred rolling MEAN over window >> dwell (rolling median tracks the majority state and eats the telegraph). Expected parity dwell 2-3 ms on BFC devices; documented operating point gamma = 200 Hz (2.5 ms dwell); default drift window 0.2 s = 80x 2.5 ms. Symmetric HMM default (charge parity has no preferred branch). mapping_probabilities = P(e|state0), P(e|state1) must come from a device-specific mapping calibration (g/e fidelity alone insufficient); default (0.1, 0.9) is ASSUMED and flagged. Emissions fixed in rate fit by default (refit absorbs drift). A clean Viterbi trace is not evidence of switching; identifiability gates are. Rate falling with bin size = noise crossings; plateau = genuine switching. Controls: flip_final_pi2 must keep telegraph (ACF amplitude ratio > 0.25) with occ1_flip ~ 1 - occ1_main (tol 0.15); echo_null must suppress (ratio < 0.25) or be unidentifiable (echo refocuses static parity detuning); tau_offset/drive_detuned/drive_off informational. Planning conventions (test asserts): tau = 1/(2 df); gap = tau - 4 sigma (no pi); echo gap = (tau - 8 sigma)/2; final pi/2 phase 180 deg standard, 0 flip, 90 symmetric, 270 symmetric+flip; symmetric drive offset -df/2 halves branch detuning; df_max = 1/(8 sigma) no-pi. History: tau was programmed as pulse-edge gap not centre-to-centre (fixed; verify checks realized c2c == 1/(2 df) within 2 tProc cycles); _plot_hmm KeyError 'mu0' with ge_mixture emissions (fixed, test guards). Zero-DAC-gain run is electrically inert; measured rep period within 3% of scheduled.

LAB NOTES - experiment:zero_span: 9-stage validation chain (spec 2026-06-01), strobe-only, collate-only EVIDENCE.md, no automated pass/fail; stages 4-6 never implemented (bin_size_sweep/threshold_stability exist but unused). Stage 2: no telegraph exists in driven steady state -> use complex-response difference vs drive-off baseline, not histogram bimodality, at the stage-1 probe point. Readout power changes both SNR and real parity dynamics -> record switch_rate, separation_snr, mean_dwell, mean_signal_level per setting; temperature logged manually. Controls: A drive off, B drive detuned, C probe off-resonance -> contrast vanishes; D swap branch -> assignment reverses (branch_sign_flip strong evidence). Z_on/Z_off proportional to S21, not calibrated. Burst sigma = max(1.4826*MAD about median, Poisson floor q*sqrt(max(baseline_counts,1)), q = 1/(window_us*1e-6)) because >50% windows have 0 switches so MAD = 0. Dwell exp fit weighted by sqrt(count): unweighted OLS biases tau ~10% high (fails +/-5% spec). Decimated captures cover one read_length end-to-end; never auto-bin by read_length (collapses to one point); pass explicit analysis_bin_us (fraction of read_length); per-sample SNR in decimated mode << strobe. is_bimodal requires delta_BIC > 0 AND separation SNR > 1.5 AND weights in (0.1, 0.9). Best bin may precede T_parity. Low tau_cv across thresholds = robust telegraph. reps_per_block must satisfy avg_maxlen (16384). Inter-chunk gaps not modelled in stitched t_us; gap_indices mark boundaries. KMeans label 0 = lower projection on inter-centroid axis with sign canonicalized to dominant +component.
